outcome: Frequency of delayed or failed neuroaxial anesthesia
Risk of airway problems (poor laryngeal visualization, failed intubation)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery (N=6393) and age-matched female patients who underwent non-obstetric abdominal or gynecological surgery (N=814) between 2005 and 2013
finding: The rate of failed intubations in patients undergoing cesarean delivery may be equivalent to that of non-obstetric patients.
mod_finding: The rate of failed intubations in patients undergoing cesarean delivery may be equivalent to that of non-obstetric patients.
